answer: A no-vector symbol-graph map is implementable and Aider ships one (tree-sitter tags + personalized PageRank, default 1024 map tokens). It is not an LSP-reference ranker. Continue-class embedding retrieval pays a vector store (LanceDB) plus embedding inference. Named comparison metric: SWE-bench Lite resolved %. Cited measurement: Aider 26.3% (79/300) without RAG; that is not a same-harness embedding baseline, so 'competitive with embedding retrieval' is downgraded to DESIGN-PREFERENCE. Scale limit: about 51715 x 4KiB files for a 5.0s cold tag-extract on this host; PageRank is not the limiter. 05-ECO :100 was not fetchable here. SUCCESS:RES-0107 in the receipt AND a cited comparison or an explicit downgrade to design-preference, plus a stated scale limit
